classes.name: انتخابات مجلس النواب (مجلس الأمة ومجلس الشعب من قبل)
classes.name_en: House of Representatives, formerly the National Assembly (1957-1971) and People's Assembly (1971-2013)
classes.note: The elected lower chamber of the republic: the National Assembly of 1957, 1964, and 1969, the People's Assembly from 1971 to its dissolution in June 2012, and the House of Representatives from 2015. The 1957 Assembly had 350 elected members. Under the 1964-2012 rules half the seats were reserved for workers and farmers. Systems: two-round majority voting in single- and two-member districts for most of the period, party lists in 1984 and 1987, and a mixed system since 2011. Since 2020, 568 elected seats: 284 individual seats in 143 constituencies by two-round majority and 284 seats in 4 closed-list districts won whole by the list with an absolute majority; up to 5 percent more are appointed by the President (Constitution art. 102; Law 46 of 2014 arts. 1, 3, and 4). Elections are held in two or three regional stages, each with a runoff.

cadence.locator: https://www.elections.eg/images/pdfs/laws/Constitution_2014.pdf (art. 106: "مدة عضوية مجلس النواب خمس سنوات ميلادية ... ويجرى انتخاب المجلس الجديد خلال الستين يوما السابقة على انتهاء مدته")
cadence.runoff_rule: Individual seats: candidates short of an absolute majority of valid votes go to a runoff between twice as many candidates as seats left (Law 46 of 2014).

dates.quote: "بموجب الاستفتاء على تعديل الدستور الذى أجرى بالخارج أيام 19، 20، 21 وبالداخل أيام 20، 21، 22 من إبريل سنة 2019"

classes.name: المجالس الشعبية المحلية للمحافظات
classes.note: Every local unit elects a council for four years by direct vote; a quarter of the seats go to people under 35, a quarter to women, and at least half to workers and farmers (Constitution art. 180). The councils under Local Administration Law 43 of 1979 were last elected in April 2008 and dissolved by court order in June 2011; no election has been held since, pending a new local administration law (art. 242).

cadence.locator: https://www.elections.eg/images/pdfs/laws/Constitution_2014.pdf (art. 180: "تنتخب كل وحدة محلية مجلسا باالقتراع العام السرى المباشر، لمدة أربع سنوات")

classes.disposition_reason: No official results of any local council election are online for 1979-2008, and none has been held under the 2014 Constitution.

classes.note: The law may provide for governors and heads of other local units to be appointed or elected (art. 179); all are appointed by the President, and village headmen (umdas) by the Interior Ministry.

classes.name_en: Professional syndicates, trade unions, and student unions
classes.note: The National Election Authority's remit covers referendums and presidential, parliamentary, and local elections only (Constitution art. 208; Law 198 of 2017).
classes.disposition_reason: Run by the bodies themselves under their own laws, not by the state's election authority, and their results are not published as public election results.
